//: How level 4 is generated. See tools/rebuild_level.ps1; this manifest is NOT replayable.
blocked: gen_islands.gd is a one-shot scaffolding template that WRITES the level scene from nothing. Re-running it silently deletes everything added since. Level 4 keeps the template allow-list and adds no spawn, but it carries a hand-drawn RoadPath circuit and racing / parked / watercraft prop dressing under AuthoringRoot. It builds all three levels in one pass, so it cannot be run for one of them alone. And it writes no splatmap2, so the committed level_4_island_splat2.png would be orphaned.
notes: Levels 2-4 share one generator and one seed table (tools/gen_islands.gd LEVELS).
To change a level's terrain you edit its seed row there and accept losing the hand work,
or you sculpt in the editor and the 'manual' step below is the whole story.

steps.why: Writes the heightmap PNG, the auto-splat PNG, the LevelInfo .tres and the level .tscn for levels 2, 3 and 4 from the seeds in its LEVELS table. Deterministic from those seeds.

steps.what: Everything since: hand paint into splatmap2, spawns and allow-list edits, roads, prop dressing, scatter.
steps.why: This is what the script step above would destroy. It is why replayable is false.
